title: Survey of pathogens and human fecal markers in stormwater across a highly populated urban region
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1354-1367
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00578C, Paper
Joshua A. Steele, Amity G. Zimmer-Faust, Thomas J. Clerkin, Adriana González-Fernández, Sarah A. Lowry, A. Denene Blackwood, Kayla Raygoza, Kylie Langlois, Alexandria B. Boehm, Rachel T. Noble, John F. Griffith, Kenneth C. Schiff
This study measured human specific fecal markers and pathogenic viruses and bacteria in stormwater across multiple watersheds using digital PCR to produce a wide geographic snapshot of microbial water quality.
